WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT tradekind, trader_count,
         SUM(trader_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(trader_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT tradekind,
       trader_count,
       trader_count::numeric / total_count AS proportion,
       trader_count - avg_count AS above_average
FROM stats
WHERE trader_count > avg_count;
